DataQuality.description:
Quality assessment of one measurement or of a window of measurements.

Data quality describes the data, not the crew member: it says how far the values
can be trusted and carries no physiological meaning. The physiological status is
reported separately, by `EvaluationStatus`.

The rules that assign `status`, `score` and `flags` belong to the data-quality
algorithm and are not part of this contract.

score.description: Overall quality from 0 (worst) to 1 (best). Null when no score is computed.
score.title: Score

completeness.description: Fraction of the expected samples that are present. Null when not applicable.
completeness.title: Completeness

algorithm.description: Algorithm that produced the assessment. Null when not assessed.

assessed_at.description: When the assessment was produced (UTC). Null when not assessed.
assessed_at.title: Assessed At

DataQuality.title: DataQuality

EvaluationStatus.description:
Physiological status of a crew member relative to the personal baseline.

It describes the crew member, not the data: how far the underlying data can be
trusted is reported separately, in `data_quality`. `insufficient_data` means
that no physiological status could be determined.

These are labels only. The rules that map a deviation to a status are owned by
the scientific algorithms and are not part of this contract: no clinical
threshold is defined here.
EvaluationStatus.title: EvaluationStatus

HealthDomain.description: Functional area a metric or an evaluation belongs to.
HealthDomain.title: HealthDomain

MetricFinding.description: Evaluation of a single metric within an evaluation window.

unit.description: Unit of the values below. Must be the canonical unit of `metric`.
unit.title: Unit

observed_value.description: Value observed in the window, aggregated as defined by the algorithm. Null when it cannot be computed.
observed_value.title: Observed Value

baseline_id.description: Baseline used for the comparison, when there is one.
baseline_id.title: Baseline Id

baseline_value.description: Reference value taken from the baseline.
baseline_value.title: Baseline Value

relative_deviation.description: `absolute_deviation` divided by `baseline_value`. Dimensionless: -0.05 means 5% below the baseline.
relative_deviation.title: Relative Deviation

explanation.description: Plain-language account of how the status was reached.
explanation.title: Explanation

data_quality.description: Quality of the data behind this finding, when assessed.

QualityFlag.description:
Specific issues found while assessing data quality.

`out_of_sensor_range` refers to the measuring range documented for the device.
It is a property of the sensor, not a clinical threshold.
QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag

QualityStatus.description:
Overall usability of the assessed data. It is not a health status.

`not_assessed` means no quality algorithm has processed the data yet.
